name: Cursing Your Parents
overview: Scripture firmly commands honoring and respecting one's parents, as seen in Exodus 20:12 which promises long life for those who do so. The seriousness of dishonoring or cursing parents is underscored by the repeated mandate in Exodus 21:15, 21:17, and Leviticus 20:9 that such actions warrant the death penalty, reflecting the gravity of rebellion within the family structure. Deuteronomy 21:18 highlights the problem of a stubborn and disobedient son who refuses correction, while Deuteronomy 27:16 pronounces a curse on those who treat their parents lightly, emphasizing the covenantal importance of honoring parental authority in God's design.
